glosses: mine (excavation from which ore is taken)
mine (device intended to explode when stepped on)

examples.text: Aquel negocio era una mina de oro.
examples.en: That business was a gold mine.

examples.text: Esta mina cerrará el mes que viene.
examples.en: This mine will close down next month.

examples.text: La navegación era difícil porque había minas.
examples.en: Navigation was difficult because there were mines.
